title: Chinese satellite images show major buildup of US E-3/KC-135 at Saudi airbase
snippet: Chinese satellite imagery confirmed large buildup of US Air Force support aircraft at Prince Sultan Airbase in Saudi Arabia — 16 KC-135 aerial tankers and 6 E-3 Sentry AWACS. Over 150 aircraft deployed to bases near Iran, approximately 12 warships assembled.
tag_reason: 이전 MizarVision 관련 보도와 유사하나, Prince Sultan AB 구체적 배치(E-3/KC-135 수량)는 신규 정보.
